name: 73020 · Choctaw, OK
findings: ZIP 73020 (Choctaw) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 73020 (Choctaw) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 73020 (Choctaw) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 23% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 52% of all organizations here have no identified type.
